headline: Holiday treats celebration approved for the Unity in the Community event; cash mob plan still open.
summary: The meeting covered the fourth-quarter cash mob, a plan to support local businesses, and ideas for a holiday event. No cash mob choice was voted on. Members approved making the Unity in the Community event a holiday treats celebration, with a special meeting planned for mid-November.
decisions: Approved making the Unity in the Community event a holiday treats celebration.
discussion: Fourth-quarter cash mob: Members weighed a public vote on Bristol Talks against a pinned holiday catalog of local businesses. Members noted that the time before December was short.

Pinned holiday catalog: Members discussed having local businesses post gift options in one pinned Bristol Talks post. One moderator was reported to believe pinning would not be an issue, and the matter was to be raised with the other moderators.

Local gift card idea: Members discussed a gift card that works only at Bristol businesses and is sold through the council. Members said it would need city funding and could be considered in a budget next year.
Unity in the Community event: Members discussed holiday food options such as a cookie swap or a potluck, and possible locations. Allergen labels, cleanup, and cost were raised as concerns.

decision_evidence.quote: Can I make a motion to vote on the fourth quarter university? University. I've been touring colleges with my kid. Unity in the community event to be our holiday treats celebration. Do I have a second? ... All in favor? Aye. Aye. Any opposed? No? Okay. Okay. Motion passes.

decision_titles: Unity in the Community event as a holiday treats celebration
